title: Entered active duty
explanation: Active duty began on 30 June 1997. Place of entry was Miami, Florida. Recruit training followed at Great Lakes that September.

title: Promoted to Chief Petty Officer
explanation: Date of rank as a chief petty officer, E-7, Electronics Technician. Other promotion dates are not in the record. Making chief changes the uniform: khakis, a fouled-anchor collar device, and a rating badge with a rocker.

title: Transferred to the Fleet Reserve
explanation: Left active duty on 28 February 2018. Fleet Reserve status was effective 1 March 2018. Character of service: Honorable. A Fleet Reserve transfer is how a sailor with twenty or more years leaves active duty and draws retainer pay. It is not a punishment. Last ship or station was Naval Hospital Jacksonville.
